segments.text: THat Chriſt roſe againe, is prooued by the teſtimonies of Angels, weomen, Euangeliſtes, Apoſtles, and other Saintes, who after his reſurrection ſawe him, felt him, and talked with him. And wee were to beleeue the Apoſtles in reſpect of the authority which they had from heauen, although they had not ſeene him.
